entities.summary: Robert Cary Brothers is an American indie rock singer-songwriter originally from Nashville, Tennessee. After moving to Los Angeles and becoming a regular performer at the influential Hotel Café venue, Brothers first gained national attention with his song "Blue Eyes" on the platinum-selling, Grammy-winning soundtrack for the movie Garden State (2006).
